extracts.37: To begin, talk to one of the guards near [[Sinclair Mansion]], located directly north of the Seers' Village. They tell you that [[Lord Sinclair]] has been murdered and they cannot figure out who killed him. Offer your help, and he says that you should question the family to gather information about the murder.
extracts.39: First, search the murder scene, which is on the eastern side of the mansion. Inside will be a [[pungent pot]] which you should collect, along with the [[criminal's dagger]].
extracts.41: Search the smashed window to find the [[criminal's thread]]. You will need to talk to the guard there to be able to investigate it. Whilst in this area, you must also investigate the wooden gate. Then, go around to the various bedrooms belonging to the suspects to find a number of silver items, all contained within barrels in each room. (There are four rooms upstairs and two on the ground floor.) Look for:
extracts.50: Tip: As soon as you figure out whose fingerprint it is, check their story about how they used their poison. Verify that their story is not true by checking that area and then talk to the guard to finish the quest. You no longer have to talk to everyone else in the mansion to be able to finish the quest.
extracts.54: Now it's time to get your first piece of evidence. Go to the Gardener's shed and search the sacks to find some [[flypaper]], you may need up to seven sheets, so collect them all if you have the inventory space. Go to the kitchen and fill your pot with flour (the kitchen is next to the stairs). Use the flour on the criminal's dagger, then use the dagger on a piece of flypaper to get an [[unknown print]] (Fill five pots with flour from the Sinclair Mansion' is also a easy [[Seers' Village Tasks|Seers' Village task]]).
extracts.56: Dust each silver item with flour and use the flypaper to lift fingerprints from the items, then compare them to the print of the silver dagger you found at the crime scene (use the unknown print together with everyone of the suspects' prints). Once you've got a match, you can drop all the other silver items. You'll need more than just that for a conviction, though.

source-register.json.title: Silver necklace

extracts.20: [[File:Silver necklace detail.png|left|100px]]The '''Silver necklace''' is a quest item used in the [[Murder Mystery]] [[quest]]. It is obtained from a barrel in [[Anna Sinclair|Anna's]] bedroom in the [[Sinclair Mansion]]. It has Anna's fingerprints on it and is used to determine if Anna is the murderer or not. If it is used on the flour barrel, it will create the [[Silver necklace (dusted)]], and [[flypaper]] is used on it, it will create [[Anna's print]], which can be compared with the [[Unknown print]] to see if Anna is the killer.
extracts.22: This item can not be made using the Crafting skill.
extracts.24: Players may wear the necklace during the quest. Players '''cannot''' obtain it after they complete the quest.
extracts.26: The only way to keep it is to drop it and take another one during the quest, and drop the second one right before you complete the quest and then pick it up again after the quest. The guard will take it away regardless of if it is floured and/or wielded, how many are you carrying or who the murderer is.
extracts.28: Note that banking it before finishing does not work either.
